capabilities: Search public image APIs such as Wikimedia Commons, Openverse, museums, NASA, PubChem, and RCSB PDB
Insert remote image URLs as Markdown with optional alt text, captions, and attribution
Filter results by provider-supplied rights and license metadata, including an open-license-only mode
Build IIIF image URLs with resizing, regions, rotation, and format options
Scan notes, folders, or the vault for remote image links and report their HTTP status and MIME type
disambiguation: "Free" means no user key or cost, not copyright-free images; results carry provider-supplied rights metadata that must still be checked.
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Images are never downloaded; inserted links stay remote, so hotlinking blocks or removed assets can break them, and the README says the Library of Congress provider may be unavailable in some network environments.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to search the open web for educational or reference images and insert them as remote URLs without downloading files into the vault.

relations.evidence: Wikimedia Commons | Public, no user key | Original file URL and thumbnail
Openverse | Public, no user key | Returned image URL and thumbnail
Internet Archive | Public Advanced Search | Archive image-service URL for image items

summary: Web image search that queries public APIs (Wikimedia, Openverse, museums, NASA) and inserts remote image URLs with rights metadata into notes.
